caption: The drawing depicts a single, narrow, elongated rectangular wooden plank positioned vertically in the center of the image. The wood is brown with visible grain and two long, parallel dark lines running along its length, suggesting grooves or marks. At the upper end, the plank is slightly rounded and has a narrow notch or groove. A thin string or cord is attached near the top, running parallel to the length of the board, and leads down near the bottom. At the lower end, the string passes through a hook or staple and is attached to a dark, teardrop-shaped object, likely made of metal, which hangs within a carved or painted oval depression on the bottom of the board. The background is a plain, light beige color with some subtle texture and shading, and no other objects are present in the composition.
title: Plumb Line and Board
